title: Hyun-Young(RAINBOW) & Sool J Project Single '오빠야(Honey)' Interview
description:
Interview of Hyun-Young(RAINBOW) and rapper Sool J 

'오빠야(Honey)' is composed by the producer behind "A Midsummer Night's Sweetness", Cosmic Sound, and written by Sool J himself. The MV featured the adorable lyrics for the romantic track, and this Interview-of clip takes you into the studio
